title: fix: read the kept-width line from the ask outcome, so a resize with nothing held stays quiet
description: Suspected DEC-154 rule-3 defect on PR opum-ai/quest-cli#486 (head 69f95100), raised by the orchestrator from a by-ref read of hooks/quest.ts keptWidthNotice and matching the defect lore-cli found in its own pane (F2, opum-ai/lore-cli#486 commit 14a5e181). keptWidthNotice fires whenever isSizeHeld(drawn, asked), and asked is re-derived from the CURRENT render (dockFullColumns of viewport + drawn + div - 24), while amended rule 2 forbids re-asking on a resize. After a GRANTED full ask, a terminal widening raises the re-derived asked while drawn stays, so the line would claim a width the person set when nothing is held. Fix if the probe test goes red: take held from the ask OUTCOME, mirroring lore-cli (only a spent ask sets it, a draw at the ask clears it). The 0.13.0 bump and pair release stay HELD: no merge, promote, tag or publish.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A board-test fixture exists at branch head 69f95100: a granted dock full ask, then a widening resize with no new ask; its verdict is recorded (red if a (you set it) line renders).
If red: full mode shows the kept-width line only while an ask has gone ungranted; after a granted ask, a widening resize with no new ask shows no (you set it) line.
If red: reverting only the fix reddens only the new test; the mod suite and the real-pty check run the way QCLI-454 did, and the new head and its CI rollup are reported.
If green: the preventing code path is named and nothing changes.

plan: Write the probe test at branch head 69f95100: a granted dock full ask, then a widening resize with no new ask; record its verdict.
If red: fix the held reading to come from the ask outcome (mirroring opum-ai/lore-cli#486 commit 14a5e181), keeping the ruled held copy and the quiet not-held case.
Mutation-pin: revert only the fix and confirm only the new test reddens.
Re-run the mod suite and the real-pty check the way QCLI-454 did; commit and push on chore/QCLI-433-bump-0-13-0; report the new head and CI rollup.
If green: name the code path that prevents the defect and change nothing.
implementationNotes: QCLI-456 DONE, 2026-10-03. The DEC-154 rule-3 defect the orchestrator read by ref is real and now fixed on chore/QCLI-433-bump-0-13-0 as commit 117275e3, head of opum-ai/quest-cli#486 re-frozen; the 0.13.0 pair release stayed HELD throughout: no merge, promote, tag or publish. RED, twice, at 69f95100. (1) The new board-test probe -- a granted dock full ask at a 200-column terminal (drawn 175 = the 176 asked), then a widening resize with no new ask -- fails on its resize assertion, drawing Width kept at 176 (you set it). (2) A real-pty run of that build draws the false line on screen: granted ask 176 (quiet), tmux widened 200x50 to 240x50, then the screen reads Width kept at 177 (you set it) and the tool line Opened the Quest board at 177 columns; the width is kept. Cause: keptWidthNotice fired wherever drawn < asked - 4, with asked re-derived from the CURRENT render; after a granted ask a widening lifts that derived ask (216 at 240 columns) while the pane keeps the grant and amended rule 2 asks nothing again -- the opum-ai/lore-cli#486 F2 defect, in this pane. FIX 117275e3: held now reads from the ask OUTCOME. openPane records the numbers the full mode asked for; the ask stands ungranted until a full draw comes within the slack; the render that fires the stored mode first ask is suppressed (it drew before the surface answered); a full-mode draw at the ask size clears it. keptWidthNotice takes that outcome instead of re-deriving the ask, and the fullAxis helper that derived it is removed. The ruled held copy is unchanged, the pane line stays quiet when nothing holds, and the kept case is unchanged. VERIFICATION. Mutation pin: reverting the fix alone (everything but the new probe test, back to 69f95100) gives 44 pass / 1 fail, the single failure exactly the new test. Suite 45 pass / 0 fail; the four pre-existing board.test.tsx tsc errors (QCLI-451) byte-identical to baseline; lint, format and typecheck green. Pty A/B: fixed+granted draws no line after the widening (probe renders: notice null, holding false, standing ask 176), and a later tool call re-asks at the new terminal (216) reporting full size; fixed+kept-80 still reads Width kept at 80 (you set it) before and after the widening; no run asks on the resize itself. CI on 117275e3: source-gates success, Tracker integrity success, lore check failure = the held pair rule (exit 6, lore 0.12.0 requires quest 0.13.0; the same red as 03a3fafa and 69f95100, not a regression), release jobs skipped; PR #486 OPEN at 117275e3, BLOCKED. One judgment call measured and dropped: an extra clear-the-ask-when-leaving-full-mode hunk made no observable difference in either client shape (pty A/B), so it is not in the commit. Rig and captures: /tmp/qcli-probe (screen-unfixed-*, screen-fixed-*, screen-fixed-kept-*, screen-toggle-*, probe.resize.jsonl). AC4 is the green arm and never applied: the probe went red, so it stays unchecked deliberately, with nothing done under it.
finalSummary: Measured and fixed the DEC-154 rule-3 defect: the kept-width line claimed a width the person set on a shortfall a resize left behind with nothing held. Held now reads from the ask outcome -- openPane records the ask, a full draw within the slack clears it, and the pre-answer render is suppressed -- pinned by a new probe test (red at 69f95100, green after) and a real-pty A/B (unfixed: false line at 177; fixed: quiet; kept at 80: still names 80). Fix commit 117275e3 on chore/QCLI-433-bump-0-13-0, re-frozen on opum-ai/quest-cli#486; the 0.13.0 pair release stays held. Suite 45/0, tsc arm unchanged, lint/format/typecheck green; the lore check red on the head is the held pair rule.
